classes.mechanism: The emptied day carries a dividend or reinvested distribution (dv / dvr; interest, int, is the same kind and is counted in the sizing) that the flow table keeps INSIDE the return, and the day's outflow is the prior day's value PLUS that income, so outflow / prior value = 1 + income / prior value. The return is income / prior value, the same number the form gives if the account were not emptied; the zero day-end value does not cause it. In 6 of 8 the prior day holds cash only and the income is a cash-sweep dividend (5 of those 5 dated on the last trading day of a month) or a dividend paid on a security sold 21 days earlier (1 of 6); in 2 of 8 a reinvested distribution of a fund that is fully withdrawn in kind (the reinvested shares leave with the rest). The base is the residual left after the account was drawn down: prior value under one dollar on 4 of 8 and on 3 of 3 of the days above 100 percent (outflow / prior value 2.00 on each). A dv equal to the whole base is a month of income posted once on the day the residual is withdrawn.

A management fee (man) is booked on the emptied day. Fee types are a drag inside the return and never a flow (METHOD_DRAG), so a fee that takes 7 percent of the prior value (one day, outflow / prior value 0.93) or the whole residual (one day, zero flow) shows as a return of about -7 percent and -100 percent. The return is after fees by the form's stated design; the outflow is below the prior value because the fee is not an outflow.

Securities leave in kind as withdrawal rows with a zero or null Amount (1 to 19 such rows on a day), which flow_rows values as abs(Quantity) x the day's price of the CUSIP. The prior day's value is the same shares at the PRIOR close, so outflow / prior value is the price move of the withdrawn securities from the prior close to the day close (end-of-day flow timing). Rebuilt from the r34 security_day_price table and the cached withdrawal quantities, outflow / prior value matches the day's to three decimals on 12 of 12 days (the ratios are 0.97 to 1.02). On 3 of the 12 the withdrawn quantity also exceeds the prior quantity by a reinvested distribution that is under 0.05 percent of the value.

Federal tax withholding (ftax) equal to the whole prior balance is the cash leaving, with no same-day withdrawal (lo) row and none within 12 days either side. A withholding is a flow only when it rides a same-day lo (R25_RIDING_WITHHOLDING, rides_withdrawal); otherwise it is INTERNAL, a drag. So the flow is zero (or only a small charge) while the value goes to zero and the return is -100 percent. Taking the same ftax as an outflow gives 0.00 on both days. The disagreement is the form's treatment of a withholding with no withdrawal, not the prior value.

not_established: Whether Commonwealth's own reported return for the same days agrees: no custodian return at day grain was read.

Class A: that the income accrued over earlier days (a month's sweep income paid once; a fund distribution paid on full redemption) is inferred from the earlier larger balance and the month-end dates, not read from a custodian statement. TRUE means the number follows from the posted data and the stated form, not that a daily figure on a sub-dollar base means anything economically.
Class B: whether the management fee booked on the emptied day is a final close-out fee is not stated in the file.
Class C: the closes are the r34 price table's own; whether each close is as-traded was not tested. The reproduction shows the number follows from that table, not that the table is right.

Class D: whether the custodian file omits the withdrawal of the net proceeds (DATA) or the whole balance was truly withheld was not settled: no lo row within 12 days either side, and for one of the two accounts no row at all after the day. Kind FORM rests on the 0.00 return when the withholding is an outflow, not on a custodian statement.

The 'other 1,733' sizes count the presence of a row type on the day, not that the day was affected: a day with one of these rows and a return under 1 percent is counted whether the effect is 0.01 percent or 0.99 percent.

Transaction effective days were recomputed with lib/trading_calendar next_trading_day; the day file's external_flow was read as produced (equal to the FWD-3 flow on 1,757 of 1,757) and not re-derived row by row.
The second CUSIP of reinvested distribution on flagged day 23 was not tested for a close step (no prior close in the table).
